label: Animated Fantasy Feature
methodology: Independent 2x2 anchor board followed by four full-size two-reference style-transfer sentinels. Content and composition come only from the matching More Naturalistic revision; rendering language comes only from this style anchor.
styleLock: Polished hand-drawn fantasy feature-animation cartoon. Clean tapered dark-colored contours with confident curves and selective internal lines; smoothly sculpted, believable anatomy with restrained appealing exaggeration—slightly emphasized heads, hands, paws, and expressions, never chibi or childish. Three-to-five clean color and value shapes, crisp cel boundaries, and very limited soft painted occlusion only where forms overlap. Broad simplified material shapes, readable silhouettes, expressive posing, high detail at faces and creature heads, medium detail on bodies and buildings, sparse atmospheric backgrounds.
colorLock: Vivid natural local colors with controlled complementary accents; palette and mood chosen separately for each subject.

anchor.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Fantasy Crux cartoon house-style exploration anchor board. Create one square 2x2 anchor board showing four separate fantasy subjects rendered by the same exact illustrator in one fully consistent style. Top-left: an adult medieval woman warrior in a quiet village courtyard, alert but not fighting, full body, practical sword and round shield. Top-right: an adult brown bear standing naturally in a forest clearing, complete body. Bottom-left: one dragon on a rocky upland in readable three-quarter pose, exactly four legs and exactly two wings, all extremities visible. Bottom-right: a small medieval village with timber-and-stone houses, central well, watchtower, paths, and vegetation, environment only. Four equal panels, narrow clean gutters, no labels or heavy border. Complete safe framing, one focal subject per character panel. Same line language, shape simplification, detail density, color construction, material logic, and surface treatment in every panel. Neutral daylight and grounded adventurous tone; do not force shared mood or palette. No fire, magic, dramatic sky, rim light, text, captions, speech balloons, logo, watermark, anime, photorealism, glossy 3D, or extra focal subjects.
